paragraphs: An ancient bus stopped by a dry river bed and a party of famous actors and actresses got off.
Dressed in dark glasses and old clothes, they had taken special precautions so that no one should recognize them.
But as they soon discovered, disguises can sometimes be too perfect.
'This is a wonderful place for a picnic,' said Gloria Gleam.
'It couldn't be better, Gloria,' Brinksley Meers agreed.
'No newspaper men, no film fans! Why don't we come more often?'
Meanwhile, two other actors Rockwall Slinger and Merlin Greeves, had carried two large food baskets to a shady spot under some trees.
When they had all made themselves comfortable, a stranger appeared.
'Now you get out of here, all of you!' he shouted.
'I'm sheriff here. Do you see that notice? It says \"No Camping\" -- in case you can't read!'
'Look, sheriff,' said Rockwall, 'don't be too hard on us. I'm Rockwall Slinger and this is Merlin Greeves.'
'Oh, is it?' said the sheriff with a sneer.
'Well, I'm Brinksley Meers, and my other name is Gloria Gleam. Now you get out of here fast!'
text:
An ancient bus stopped by a dry river bed and a party of famous actors and actresses got off.

Dressed in dark glasses and old clothes, they had taken special precautions so that no one should recognize them.

But as they soon discovered, disguises can sometimes be too perfect.

'This is a wonderful place for a picnic,' said Gloria Gleam.

'It couldn't be better, Gloria,' Brinksley Meers agreed.

'No newspaper men, no film fans! Why don't we come more often?'

Meanwhile, two other actors Rockwall Slinger and Merlin Greeves, had carried two large food baskets to a shady spot under some trees.

When they had all made themselves comfortable, a stranger appeared.

He looked very angry.

'Now you get out of here, all of you!' he shouted.

'I'm sheriff here. Do you see that notice? It says \"No Camping\" -- in case you can't read!'

'Look, sheriff,' said Rockwall, 'don't be too hard on us. I'm Rockwall Slinger and this is Merlin Greeves.'

'Oh, is it?' said the sheriff with a sneer.

'Well, I'm Brinksley Meers, and my other name is Gloria Gleam. Now you get out of here fast!'
paragraphs_cn: 一辆破旧的汽车停在一条干涸的河床边，一群著名的男女演员走了下来。
他们戴着墨镜，穿着旧衣服，特意采取了预防措施，以免有人认出他们。
但正如他们很快发现的那样，伪装有时可能太完美了。
“这是野餐的绝妙地方，”格洛里亚·格利姆说。
“再好不过了，格洛里亚，”布林克斯利·米尔斯表示同意。
“没有记者，没有影迷！我们为什么不常来呢？”
与此同时，另外两位演员罗克沃尔·斯林格和默林·格里夫斯已经把两个大食品篮搬到了树下一块阴凉的地方。
当他们都安顿舒服了以后，一个陌生人出现了。
“你们全都从这儿出去！”他喊道。
“我是这里的警长。你们看见那块牌子了吗？上面写着‘禁止野营’——以防你们不识字！”
“听着，警长，”罗克沃尔说，“别对我们太苛刻了。我是罗克沃尔·斯林格，这位是默林·格里夫斯。”
“那好，我是布林克斯利·米尔斯，我的另一个名字叫格洛里亚·格利姆。现在你们赶快从这儿出去！”
text_cn:
一辆破旧的汽车停在一条干涸的河床边，一群著名的男女演员走了下来。

他们戴着墨镜，穿着旧衣服，特意采取了预防措施，以免有人认出他们。

但正如他们很快发现的那样，伪装有时可能太完美了。

“这是野餐的绝妙地方，”格洛里亚·格利姆说。

“再好不过了，格洛里亚，”布林克斯利·米尔斯表示同意。

“没有记者，没有影迷！我们为什么不常来呢？”

与此同时，另外两位演员罗克沃尔·斯林格和默林·格里夫斯已经把两个大食品篮搬到了树下一块阴凉的地方。

当他们都安顿舒服了以后，一个陌生人出现了。

他看上去非常生气。

“你们全都从这儿出去！”他喊道。

“我是这里的警长。你们看见那块牌子了吗？上面写着‘禁止野营’——以防你们不识字！”

“听着，警长，”罗克沃尔说，“别对我们太苛刻了。我是罗克沃尔·斯林格，这位是默林·格里夫斯。”

“哦，是吗？”警长冷笑着说。

“那好，我是布林克斯利·米尔斯，我的另一个名字叫格洛里亚·格利姆。现在你们赶快从这儿出去！”
